item.title: ScagJPT
item.description:
Title: ScagJPT
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Utilities
Developer: The Axolotl Sun
Publisher: The Axolotl Sun
Franchise: Regretevator
Release Date: Aug 21, 2026




About This Software

Scag wants into your desktop, so let her in!

Scag can't give you the world, but she can get pretty close (Probably). The way she'll do this is by bumming out on your desktop! Let her walk around and hang out on your computer screen.

Having Scag will let you :

  • Use her Clock app (It comes with multiple functionalities)

    • The Alarm functionality allows you to set alarms for ANY DURATION YOU'D LIKE .

    • The Stopwatch functionality allows you to time anything you'd like by manually stopping and starting the timer.

    • Pomodoro clock: A pomodoro clock is a clock that helps increase productivity via the "Pomodoro Technique." This technique is said to decrease the amount of mental interruptions by giving the user stimuli to associate with working and taking a break. The timer will start with 25 minutes of work, then 5 minutes for a short break. This loop will repeat four times and on the fifth time will increase the break to 30 minutes. Apparently this helps with productivity so we wanted scag to have an app for it.

  • Click "The Square & Circle Show" clicker

    • It's for you.

  • Watch videos on her

    • Scag has a video player, you (as the user) can input most forms of video files into scag and she'll play them on her screen! ( She accepts "webm","mkv","flv","vob","ogv","mng","avi","mts","m2ts","ts","mov", "qt","wmv","yuv","rm","rmvb","viv","asf","amv","mp4","m4p","mp2","mpe", "mpv","mpg","mpeg","m2v","m4v","svi","3gp","3g2","mxf","roq","nsv","flv", "f4v","f4p","f4a", and "f4b" )

    • She also accepts images and gifs!

  • Throw her

    • It's a little rude, but its fun and easy.

  • Punch her

    • its fun and easy!

  • Be in her presence

    • You can say hi to her as well.

  • Let her walk around on your desktop

    • She enjoys short digital walks around your desktop landscape if you enable her to be able to do so in the settings menu.

item.title: The Sorting Bureau
item.description:
Title: The Sorting Bureau
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Apelsinka Games
Publisher: Apelsinka Games
Franchise: Mariia Skokova , Apelsinka Games , Dmitrii Zaitsev
Release Date: Aug 21, 2026




About This Game

Every Item Has Its Place

A desk covered in someone's life. Vintage buttons, foreign coins, delicate stamps, old gears, and forgotten sweets. Pick up each item and find where it belongs.

Every Material Has Its Sound

Metal clinks. Fabric rustles. Wood thuds. Each item snaps into its container with a satisfying click. The kind of sound you want to hear over and over.

Stories Told Through Objects

Every request comes from someone real. A watchmaker and his gears. A pastry chef and her molds. A manga artist buried in brushes and sketches. They bring their boxes and ask for help. Sort through their things and piece together their stories.

Your Evening Ritual

New boxes show up every morning. New clients, new items, new sorting rules. Your quiet evening never runs out.

Features

  • Sort hundreds of tactile items across dozens of themed desks
  • No timers, no penalties, no scores. Play at your own pace
  • ASMR sound design: every material sounds different
  • Charming clients, each with their own personality and story
  • Endless requests. There's always another desk waiting
  • A cozy workshop tucked away in a quiet Tokyo neighborhood

item.title: VHOLUME
item.description:
Title: VHOLUME
Genre: Casual , Indie
Developer: Nathan Grange , Léonard Lemaitre , Niels Tiercelin
Publisher: IronEqual
Release Date: Aug 21, 2026




About This Game

In the derelict capital of Afro-Eurasia, ruled by an all-controlling Ministry, Robert embarks on a b ureaucratic quest to restore his family’s revoked ration tickets .

Movement-centric gameplay where the player can jump, run, climb and slide with great freedom . Environments challenge both agility and creativity .

Mastery-driven players can exploit momentum, discover shortcuts , and break the labyrinthine design, making each run a test of skill and efficiency as they chase target times .

Play solo, or join friends in multiplayer and experience every level together.

See other players’ ghosts, share your own, and discover new ways through each level.

Steam workshop support: Play levels made by the community or create your own.

item.title: Moo Who?
item.description:
Title: Moo Who?
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie
Developer: SAT Productions
Publisher: SAT Productions
Release Date: Aug 21, 2026




About This Game

Moo Who? is a multiplayer voice-mimicry party game where animal players hide among NPC herds while hunters try to figure out who is fake.

Sound Like an Animal

Every animal player must use their microphone to mimic their assigned species.

Moo like a cow. Cluck like a chicken. Oink like a pig. Baa like a sheep.

Just make it believable enough to survive.

Don’t Let the Flies Find You

You can’t hide silently forever.

When the sound-pressure moment begins, make your animal sound before it is too late. If you fail, buzzing flies will appear around you and make your location easier for hunters to spot.

Shoot Only When You’re Sure

Hunters carry a shotgun, but every shot matters.

Shoot the wrong animal and you waste your chance. Shoot the real player and the hunters get closer to victory.

Play With Friends

Play online with 2–8 players in short, chaotic matches full of panic, suspicion, fake confidence, wrong accusations, and terrible animal sounds.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with localization, some in-game GUI icons and sfx.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Microphone required
    • Additional Notes: A stable internet connection and working microphone are required for online multiplayer.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 8 MB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Microphone required
    • Additional Notes: Headset microphone recommended for the best voice-mimicry experience.
